composition.elementLabel: Gen AI Agent Record List Header
Gen AI Workflow Record List Header

value.message: AI agents, agentic workflows, and associated tools each have access control lists (ACLs). Each of these ACLs must be passed for the AI agent to work properly for the user. This is determined by checking the user’s permissions against the ACLs.

• Passed: ACL requirements were met and access was granted
  • Blocked: ACL requirements were not met and access was not granted
  • Skipped: ACL requirements were not checked because they were not required
  • Undefined: No ACL requirements were set
